feature_name: Set language codes for data stores
summary: Introduces support for configuring language codes on Vertex AI Search data stores to improve extractive segments and extractive answers in search results.
extended_definition: Introduces support for configuring language codes on Vertex AI Search data stores to improve extractive segments and extractive answers in search results.
